name: Space-Track Source
description: Parse Space-Track GP and GP-history JSON (omm-gp-json, Alpha-5 catalog numbers read) into canonical SDS OMM records and SATCAT JSON into CAT records. Retrieval, credentials, the request rate and storage belong to the SDN host flow.

methods.displayName: Read Space-Track GP or GP history as OMM

acceptedTypeSets.description: One Space-Track gp or gp_history response as the REST API serves it (omm-gp-json): a JSON array of flat objects whose values are text, bounded to 256 MiB.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Canonical size-prefixed OMM records in input order, one per element set that could be read, without padding between them.

outputPorts.description: Canonical size-prefixed OMM records in input order, one per element set that could be read, without padding between them.
